intent: A gothic forest ballgown: a deep-moss bodice with slim dark sleeves and gill-ruffled wrists, a sickly lichen sash at the waist and a matching lichen tier in a wide mushroom-gill skirt under a toadstool-cap bonnet; from the high camera it reads as a narrow cinched top over a bright-rimmed bell.
requests: A tapered cone or elliptical skirt tier: cylinders only give round straight drums, so the skirt steps in shelves instead of a smooth bell.
A translucent gauze for the veil, so the moon could show through the moss.
